Q: Node.js React error: @vitejs/plugin-react can't detect preamble A:

This is a Vite-specific error, and the key clue is this sentence:

“Next I open stack-details.html page in browser … Empty page is shown.”

✅ Root cause (very important)

You are opening stack-details.html directly (e.g. file:///.../stack-details.html) instead of loading it through the Vite dev server.

When that happens:

  • Vite does not run

  • @vitejs/plugin-react cannot inject its JSX preamble

  • React JSX is never transformed

  • You get

    @vitejs/plugin-react can't detect preamble

This error often points at export default even though the real problem is how the page is loaded, not your component code.

✅ Correct way to open multiple HTML pages in Vite

1️⃣ Start Vite (mandatory)

npm run dev

You’ll see something like:

Local: http://localhost:5173/

2️⃣ Open the page via the dev server

NOT

file:///.../stack-details.html

YES

http://localhost:5173/stack-details.html

Vite only transforms JSX, injects the React preamble, and applies plugins when served through its dev server or build.

✅ Your files are mostly fine, but fix these small issues

🔧 1. Import React and StrictMode

With Vite + React, this usually works without explicit React import, but when debugging it’s safer.

/src/stack-details.jsx

import React from 'react'
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'
import StackDetails from './pages/TestStackDetails.jsx'

const root = document.getElementById('root')

ReactDOM.createRoot(root).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <StackDetails />
  </React.StrictMode>
)

pages/TestStackDetails.jsx

import React from 'react'

function StackDetails() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center mb-4">
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-800">Overview</h2>
    </div>
  )
}

export default StackDetails

✅ 3. Ensure Vite React plugin is installed & enabled

vite.config.js

import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
})

✅ Summary

Why this happened

  • You opened the HTML file directly

  • Vite never ran

  • React JSX preamble was never injected

How to fix

  • Always use npm run dev

  • Open pages via http://localhost:5173/stack-details.html

  • Never use file:// with Vite + React

If you want, I can also show:

  • how to navigate between pages without multiple HTML files

  • or how to use React Router instead

  • or how to pass stack name via query params correctly

Just tell me 👍

Q: Filter df where each row and item is unique A:

Here I am Solving this using Polars. Using, Pandas has already been answered by others. Any Polars interested person will find this useful.

import polars as pl
import polars.selectors as cs

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "CategoryA": ["M&M", "Skittles", "Peppermint", "Skittles"],
        "SizeA":     ["Mini", "Reg",      "Reg",       "Mini"],
        "PriceA":    [2.00,   4.00,       6.00,        3.00],

        "CategoryB": ["Kisses", "Rolo",  "Nerds",    "Skittles"],
        "SizeB":     ["Reg",    "Reg",   "Mini",     "Reg"],
        "PriceB":    [3.00,     2.00,    1.50,       4.00],

        "CategoryC": ["Skittles", "Kisses", "KitKat", "Rolo"],
        "SizeC":     ["Mini",     "Reg",    "Mini",   "Reg"],
        "PriceC":    [3.00,       3.00,     4.00,     2.00],
    }
)


base_fields = ["Category", "Size", "Price"]

# from "CategoryA", "CategoryB", "CategoryC" we extract "A","B","C"
prefix = "Category"

slots = sorted({c.removeprefix(prefix) for c in df.columns if c.startswith(prefix)})
'''
slots
['A', 'B', 'C']
'''

'''
Let us Build a struct expression per slot :
cA = struct(CategoryA, SizeA, PriceA), cB = ..., etc.

"CategoryA" -> remove suffix "A" -> "Category"
Same with size and price. 
Resulting Data inside the cell : 
{"Category": "M&M", "Size": "Mini", "Price": 2.00}
Then it will look like this: 
cA: {"Category": "M&M", "Size": "Mini"}
cB: {"Category": "M&M", "Size": "Mini"}

'''
candyStructExprs = [
    pl.struct(
        cs.ends_with(slot).name.map(lambda n: n.removesuffix(slot))
    ).alias(f"c{slot}")
    for slot in slots
]

long1 = (df.with_row_index('row')
.select('row',*candyStructExprs)       
.unpivot(index ='row',value_name ='candy')

)#.select(['row','candy'])
print('long1')
print(long1)

long11 = long1.with_columns(
 pl.col('row').min().over('candy').alias('firstRow')   
)

'''
┌─────┬──────────┬─────────────────────────────────┬──────────┐
│ row ┆ variable ┆ candy                           ┆ firstRow │
│ --- ┆ ---      ┆ ---                             ┆ ---      │
│ u32 ┆ str      ┆ struct[9]                       ┆ u32      │
╞═════╪══════════╪═════════════════════════════════╪══════════╡
│ 0   ┆ cA       ┆ {null,null,null,"M&M","Mini",2… ┆ 0        │
│ 1   ┆ cA       ┆ {null,null,null,"Skittles","Re… ┆ 1        │
│ 2   ┆ cA       ┆ {null,null,null,"Peppermint","… ┆ 2        │
│ 3   ┆ cA       ┆ {null,null,null,"Skittles","Mi… ┆ 3        │
│ 0   ┆ cB       ┆ {"Kisses","Reg",3.0,null,null,… ┆ 0        │

'''
keepFlags = long11.group_by('row').agg(
    (pl.col('row') == pl.col('firstRow')).all().alias('keep')
)
'''
┌─────┬──────┐
│ row ┆ keep │
│ --- ┆ ---  │
│ u32 ┆ bool │
╞═════╪══════╡
│ 2   ┆ true │
│ 1   ┆ true │
│ 0   ┆ true │
│ 3   ┆ true │
└─────┴──────┘
'''
res1 = df.with_row_index('row').join(
keepFlags, on = 'row'    
).drop(["row", "keep"])
print(res1)
'''
┌────────────┬───────┬────────┬───────────┬───┬────────┬───────────┬───────┬────────┐
│ CategoryA  ┆ SizeA ┆ PriceA ┆ CategoryB ┆ … ┆ PriceB ┆ CategoryC ┆ SizeC ┆ PriceC │
│ ---        ┆ ---   ┆ ---    ┆ ---       ┆   ┆ ---    ┆ ---       ┆ ---   ┆ ---    │
│ str        ┆ str   ┆ f64    ┆ str       ┆   ┆ f64    ┆ str       ┆ str   ┆ f64    │
╞════════════╪═══════╪════════╪═══════════╪═══╪════════╪═══════════╪═══════╪════════╡
│ M&M        ┆ Mini  ┆ 2.0    ┆ Kisses    ┆ … ┆ 3.0    ┆ Skittles  ┆ Mini  ┆ 3.0    │
│ Skittles   ┆ Mini  ┆ 3.0    ┆ Skittles  ┆ … ┆ 4.0    ┆ Rolo      ┆ Reg   ┆ 2.0    │
│ Peppermint ┆ Reg   ┆ 6.0    ┆ Nerds     ┆ … ┆ 1.5    ┆ KitKat    ┆ Mini  ┆ 4.0    │
│ Skittles   ┆ Reg   ┆ 4.0    ┆ Rolo      ┆ … ┆ 2.0    ┆ Kisses    ┆ Reg   ┆ 3.0    │
└────────────┴───────┴────────┴───────────┴───┴────────┴───────────┴───────┴────────┘
'''
